**Two tiers, both must pass per request** (`lib/ratelimit.ts`):

| Tier | Limit | Window | Purpose |
|------|-------|--------|---------|
| Short | 5 msg | 1 minute (sliding) | Blocks burst spam |
| Long | 30 msg | 1 day (sliding) | Blocks sustained abuse |

**Rate-limit key**: `${ip}:${visitorId}` — IP (from `x-forwarded-for`) combined with a `visitor_id` cookie so visitors behind shared NATs (offices, mobile carriers) aren't collectively throttled.

**Visitor cookie**: `HttpOnly; SameSite=Lax; Secure`, 30-day `Max-Age`, minted on first request if absent.

**Backend — two modes:**
1. **Upstash Redis** (production) — globally consistent sliding-window counters across all edge regions, persists across deploys. Triggered when `UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_URL`/`KV_REST_API_URL` env vars are set.
2. **In-memory fallback** (dev / no Redis) — per-edge-instance `Map`, resets on cold start. Same thresholds, same logic.

**On block**: returns `429` with `Retry-After`, `X-RateLimit-Limit`, `X-RateLimit-Remaining`, `X-RateLimit-Reset` headers. Both tiers are checked in parallel (Upstash path) or sequentially short-then-long (memory path).

**Key files**: `lib/ratelimit.ts` (all logic + constants), `app/api/chat/route.ts:129-163` (key construction, cookie handling, 429 response).
